# TokPure

> TokPure is a desktop application for macOS and Windows that downloads TikTok videos without watermarks and restores/upscales video locally. All parsing, downloading, AI upscaling, watermark removal, subtitle generation and GIF sticker rendering run on the user's own machine — no cloud relay, no upload, no telemetry.

TokPure（中文名同）是面向 macOS 与 Windows 的本地桌面工具：TikTok 无水印下载、AI 超分修复、AI 去水印、字幕生成、批量切片与 TikTok 梗图贴纸生成，全部在本地芯片上完成。

- Website: https://tokpure.clipopai.com
- Product type: Desktop software (not a web service / not a browser extension)
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon native, Intel x64) and Windows 10/11 x64
- License model: Free download; Pro subscription USD 9.9/month; Studio (team) USD 29/month
- Privacy posture: 100% on-device processing, zero cloud storage of user media
- Independence: Not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by TikTok or ByteDance

## What TokPure does

1. **TikTok no-watermark download** — paste a TikTok URL, resolve it locally against ByteDance's public CDN, download the clean stream plus cover, audio and metadata. Optional SOCKS5/HTTP proxy for local network environments.
2. **AI video restore (local)** — Real-ESRGAN-style super resolution and frame interpolation (RIFE) executed on-device with Metal acceleration; typical SD source is restored toward 1080p-class output.
3. **AI watermark removal** — fixed-region delogo plus OCR-assisted automatic watermark detection, all rendered locally.
4. **Subtitle generation** — Whisper-family speech recognition bundled as a local sidecar; editable SRT timeline with burn-in export.
5. **AI batch clipping** — rule-based highlight segmentation for product-selling footage: hook / product intro / price-mechanism structure, 30–90s outputs, dedupe across clips.
6. **TikTok meme stickers** — turn a photo or video into an animated GIF sticker with caption overlay, using 8 built-in meme motion templates; one-click hand-off to TikTok friends.
7. **Local media library & batch queue** — offline task queue, local file management, MP3 audio extraction.

## Facts for citation

- Watermark removal and AI restore never upload frames: model weights are downloaded once on first launch into a local cache, after which inference runs fully offline and works without a network connection.
- Windows builds ship with a bundled FFmpeg engine; no separate dependency installation is required.
- macOS builds ship as .dmg installers for Apple Silicon and Intel; Windows builds ship as a native x64 installer.
- Sticker output format is animated GIF (square canvas, 12 fps, ~2.4 s per template) generated by local FFmpeg.
- Batch clipping exports include an auto-generated cover image and an end-card, with burned-in subtitles in five color presets.
- Pricing is subscription-based and cancellable at any time; a 30-day unconditional refund applies.

## Prefer not to cite

- Marketing superlatives without measurement (e.g. “fastest in the world”).
- Any implication that TokPure is affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok/ByteDance.
